name: Quality
description: ESS-0005 Quality Center: executable Chapter-12 validation, non-authorizing Governance/Compliance orchestration, eight-gate evidence evaluation, deterministic quality scoring, technical-debt management, measured test-area coverage, QM documentation consistency and EventMesh lifecycle publication.

events.note: Quality lifecycle events use the existing EventMesh composition adapter. Event delivery never authorizes merge, release, deployment or production mutation.

implementedAreas: Chapter12ValidatorRunner for all 16 mandatory validator identities
CoverageCollector with executable-test-area measurement and optional code-coverage ingestion
real Test Score provider from mandatory test-area coverage
real Security Score provider from established SecurityComplianceAuditor aggregation semantics
TechnicalDebtRegister with evidence-required resolution and lifecycle event publication
EventMesh lifecycle publication through existing EventBus

mandatoryValidatorImplementationCoverage.note: Implementation availability is not repository conformance. Chapter12ValidationReport carries actual PASS/FAIL/NOT_AVAILABLE evidence.

remainingContractScope: complete execution evidence for Contract/Test/Build and all eight quality gates
measured providers for Documentation, Architecture, Knowledge, Metadata and Twin score axes
line/branch/function/statement coverage requires a real coverage-summary artifact and remains NOT_AVAILABLE when absent

authorityBoundary: Quality results are measurement/evidence only and cannot authorize merge, release, deployment, production mutation, policy changes or privilege elevation.
